archetypes.name: plan-cli-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Plan-quality verbs replace shell contracts consumed by /design gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new plan_quality CLI verbs against the legacy machine contracts. Focus on TSV rendering, VALIDATE_* stdout, plan-size rc/status semantics, and VALIDATE_LOG_FILE durability. Check that quiet-mode capture remains parseable for Bash callers Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: design-callsite-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Several design shell callers now invoke Python directly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace design-driver, postplan, publish, auto-fix, Gate B dedup, Step 3, and run-step1 call sites. Verify environment propagation, plugin-root fallback, override compatibility, and Bash quoting around python/cli.py plan invocations Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
